annotation.notes: Q: 'What are the obligations of notifying authorities?' IMPORTANT annotation note: all obligations here have role [] (empty) — but that does NOT mean exclude, because the SUBJECT of this question is the authority itself, not a provider/deployer. The 'exclude role []' heuristic only applies when the question is asked from a regulated-entity viewpoint. Required core: OBL-ART28-1 (Member States must designate a notifying authority responsible for assessing/monitoring conformity assessment bodies — the definition) and OBL-ART28-3 (must prevent conflicts of interest, be objective and impartial — a defining feature of a trustworthy authority). Supporting: 28-2 ('may' delegate to accreditation body — permission, not duty), 28-4 (decision separation), 28-5 (no commercial activities), 28-6 (confidentiality), 28-7 (competent personnel). CONFORMITY-ASSESSMENT COVERAGE GAP noted separately: the broader 'how is a high-risk system certified?' path is scattered across Art. 6/16/43/44 mentions in text, not a contiguous structured path — candidate future finding.
